verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication token that stores keys in a secure element and performs cryptographic operations. It has no user-data workspace from which AI insights could be generated, so this AI-insights axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or insight feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
